1.text: Abafarisayo n'abanditsi bamwe bavuye i Yerusalemu, bateranira aho ari.

2.text: Babona abigishwa be bamwe barisha ibyokurya byabo intoki zihumanye, (bisobanurwa ngo zitajabitse mu mazi,

3.text: kuko Abafarisayo n'Abayuda bose bataryaga batabanje kujabika intoki mu mazi ngo zibe zihumanuwe, bakurikije imigenzo ya ba sekuruza.

4.text: Kandi iyo babaga bavuye mu iguriro, ntibaryaga batabanje kwiyibiza mu mazi ngo babe bahumanutse. Hariho n'ibindi byinshi bategetswe na ba sekuruza babo kubiziririza, nko kujabika ibikombe n'inzabya n'inkono z'imiringa.)

5.text: Abafarisayo n'abanditsi baramubaza bati “Ni iki gituma abigishwa bawe bataziririza imigenzo ya ba sekuruza, bagapfa kurisha ibyokurya intoki zihumanye?”

6.text: Arabasubiza ati “Yesaya yahanuye ibyanyu neza mwa ndyarya mwe, nk'uko byanditswe ngo‘Ubu bwoko bunshimisha iminwa yabo,Ariko imitima yabo indi kure.

7.text: Bansengera ubusa,Kuko inyigisho bigisha ari amategeko y'abantu.’

9.text: Kandi ati “Musuzugura neza itegeko ry'Imana ngo muziririze imigenzo yanyu,

10.text: kuko Mose yavuze ati ‘Wubahe so na nyoko’, kandi ati ‘Uzatuka se cyangwa nyina bamwice.’

11.text: Nyamara mwebweho muravuga muti: Umuntu nabwira se cyangwa nyina ati ‘Icyo najyaga kugufashisha ni Korubani’ (risobanurwa ngo ‘Ituro ry'Imana’),

12.text: muba mutakimukundiye kugifashisha se cyangwa nyina,

13.text: nuko ijambo ry'Imana mukarihindura ubusa kugira ngo mukomeze imigenzo yanyu yababayemo akarande. Kandi hariho n'ibindi byinshi mukora nk'ibyo.”

14.text: Arongera ahamagara abantu arababwira ati “Mutege amatwi mwese munyumve.

15.text: Ntakinjira mu muntu kivuye inyuma ngo kimuhumanye, ahubwo ibiva mu muntu ni byo bimuhumanya. [

16.text: Niba hari umuntu ufite amatwi yumva niyumve.]”

17.text: Nuko avuye mu bantu yinjira mu nzu, abigishwa be bamubaza iby'uwo mugani.

18.text: Na we arababaza ati “Mbese namwe ntimugira ubwenge? Ntimuzi yuko ikintu kinjiye mu muntu kivuye inyuma atari cyo kimuhumanya,

19.text: kuko kitajya mu mutima we ahubwo kijya mu nda, kikanyura mu nzira yacyo?” Uko ni ko kubonezwa kw'ibyokurya byose.

20.text: Aravuga ati “Ibiva mu muntu ni byo bimuhumanya,

21.text: kuko mu mitima y'abantu havamo imigambi mibi, guheheta no gusambana,

22.text: kwiba no kwica, kwifuza kubi no kugira nabi, uburiganya n'iby'isoni nke, ijisho ribi n'ibitutsi, ubwibone n'ubupfu.

23.text: Ibyo bibi byose biva mu muntu ni byo bimuhumanya.”

24.text: Arahaguruka arahava ajya mu gihugu cy'i Tiro n'i Sidoni. Yinjira mu nzu adashaka ko hagira ubimenya, ariko ntiyabasha kwihisha.

25.text: Uwo mwanya umugore ufite umukobwa muto utewe na dayimoni amwumvise araza, yikubita imbere y'ibirenge bye.

26.text: Uwo mugore yari Umugirikikazi, ubwoko bwe ni Umusirofoyinike, aramwinginga ngo yirukane dayimoni mu mukobwa we.

27.text: Aramubwira ati “Reka abana babanze bahage, kuko atari byiza kwenda ibyokurya by'abana ngo ubijugunyire imbwa.”

28.text: Na we aramusubiza ati “Ni koko Mwami, ariko imbwa zo ziri munsi y'ameza zirya ubuvungukira bw'abana.”

29.text: Aramubwira ati “Ubwo uvuze utyo igendere, dayimoni avuye mu mukobwa wawe.”

30.text: Asubira mu nzu ye, asanga wa mwana aryamye ku buriri dayimoni amuvuyemo.

31.text: Ava mu gihugu cy'i Tiro anyura i Sidoni, agera ku nyanja y'i Galilaya anyuze hagati y'i Dekapoli.

32.text: Bamuzanira igipfamatwi kandi kidedemanga, baramwinginga ngo agishyireho ikiganza.

33.text: Agikura mu bantu aracyihererana, agishyira intoki mu matwi, acira amacandwe agikora ku rurimi.

34.text: Arararama areba mu ijuru, asuhuza umutima arakibwira ati “Efata” risobanurwa ngo “Zibuka.”

35.text: Amatwi ye arazibuka, n'intananya y'ururimi rwe irahambuka avuga neza.

36.text: Arabihanangiriza ngo batagira uwo babibwira, ariko uko yarushagaho kubihanangiriza, ni na ko barushagaho kumwamamaza rwose.

37.text: Baratangara cyane bikabije baravuga bati “Byose abikoze neza: azibura ibipfamatwi kandi akavugisha ibiragi.”
